metadata.case_name: LIU YUK LIN v. JOHNSON CLEANING SERVICES CO LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: patroller in Wo Hop Shek public cemetery

injuries.description: mild soft tissue injuries to her head
source: I find that the plaintiff only suffered from abrasions to her neck and lower face with mild soft tissue injuries to her head (amongst perhaps some other areas).
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of unspecified part of head

injuries.description: abrasions to her neck and lower face
source: I find that the plaintiff only suffered from abrasions to her neck and lower face with mild soft tissue injuries to her head (amongst perhaps some other areas).
On examination, some abrasions at the neck and lower face regions but no neurological deficit were found.
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of other or unspecified sites of head

manifestations.description: insomnia (could only sleep for about 2 hours every night)
episodes of headache of 10 degrees lasting about 2 seconds during which she could not move her hands
abrasions at the neck and lower face regions

source: She was given panadol at 13:50 and was noted to be stable after observation. She was then discharged home with panadol.
She was admitted to the AED observation ward and given injections for dizziness and oral painkillers.
She has undergone physiotherapy for alleged persistent headaches, dizziness, neck, shoulder and back pains etc.
She has also consulted clinical psychology.

treatments_received.treatment: follow-up in neurological and orthopaedics departments
source: continued to attend various clinics, was followed-up in neurological and orthopaedics departments and has undergone physiotherapy for alleged persistent headaches, dizziness, neck, shoulder and back pains etc.

treatments_received.treatment: X-ray of cervical spine and CT scan of the brain (diagnostic imaging)
source: X-ray of cervical spine showed no fracture. CT scan of the brain showed no fracture or haemorrhage.

losses.description: persistent headache and dizziness, as well as neck pain, shoulder pain and other complaints since the accident

comparable_cases.case_name: Tam Fu Yip Fip v Sincere Engineering & Trading Co. Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: referenced in relation to an injury less serious than a typical whiplash injury
